title: Vibe Coding Kit task packet
description: The contract an orchestrator dispatches to one worker. Validated by src/orchestration/handoff-contract.mjs (validateTaskPacket), which also enforces the role-specific rules stated in the descriptions below.

outOfScope.description: What the worker must not touch.

writeScope.description: "none" for explorer, reviewer and sub-planner; a non-empty list of paths for a module owner.

worktree.description: Absolute path of the pre-created worktree; required for a module owner.

candidateSha.description: Required for a reviewer: the one commit it reviews.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Required for module-owner, reviewer and sub-planner packets.

slot.description: The granted per-host slot; required when heavy is true.

offloadDir.description: Absolute path for the worker's canvas, logs and long output.

nestedDispatch.description: Only a module-owner or sub-planner packet may set this to true.
